source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of nervous coordination (PDF 25-26).

blocks.text: Zinda rehne ke liye har janwar ko apne mahol ki tabdeeliyan mehsoos kar ke un ka jawab dena hota hai, aur us ke aaza aur nizamon ki sargarmiyan, jaise dil ki dharkan, saans aur hazma, murattab (coordinated) honi chahiyen ta ke har aik jism ki zaroorat ke mutabiq chale.

items: Nervous coordination, jise nervous system qaboo karta hai, barqi (electrical) signals se.
Chemical coordination, jise endocrine system qaboo karta hai.

blocks.text: Nervous coordination mein nervous system jism ko bairooni mahol se aur jism ke mukhtalif hisson ko aapas mein barqi signals ke zariye murattab karta hai. Yeh chapter insani nervous system ke baare mein hai.

blocks.title: Shehar ki misaal
blocks.text: Jism ko aik bara shehar samjhiye. Shehar theek chalne ke liye traffic lights, emergency services aur bijli ghar sab ko aapas mein baat karni hoti hai; yahi baat cheet coordination hai.

blocks.prompt: Insanon mein coordination ki do qismein aur har aik ke peeche nizam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Nervous coordination nervous system se (barqi signals) aur chemical coordination endocrine system se (hormones).

items: Coordination ki do qismein: nervous (barqi signals) aur chemical (endocrine).
